settings.title: Confessional witnesses
settings.explainer: The assistant compares your convictions against the historical confessional traditions (Westminster, Heidelberg, Augsburg, etc.) as witnesses to the exegetical work the faithful church has done. The biblical text remains the authority — traditions only confirm your reading or signal edges where it tensions distinctive doctrines. Enabled by default as part of the method. Each change is recorded in the audit log.
settings.toggleHelp: When active, the 14 confessional traditions act as witnesses on distinctive doctrines. Core doctrines (Trinity, Chalcedon, etc.) are always verified, independent of this toggle.
settings.optOutWarning: Disabling this toggle silences part of the pastoral method. Core doctrines (universal ecumenical) still fire, but distinctives and legitimate disagreements do not. If you have a specific reason, record it below.
settings.justificationPlaceholder: Explain why you want to operate without confessional witnesses. For example: "Preparing exclusively exegetical material without explicit doctrinal contrast" or "Academic session of pure textual analysis".
settings.rosterHelp: The 14 traditions from the CORE Library catalog. When the toggle is on, all act as plural witnesses — you do not pick a single anchor tradition.

toasts.disabled: Confessional witnesses disabled — recorded in audit log

gate.flagDisabled: The pastoral fidelity flow is disabled for your account. Contact your administrator to enable it.
